Both traces solve the puzzle by first identifying two fixed attribute blocks—(Elm, 1712, Cloth) and (Maple, 1715, Vellum)—and recognizing they must be adjacent with the latter immediately left of the former. They diverge in their choice of index variable: Trace 1 tracks the position of 1712 (k), while Trace 2 tracks the position of 1715 (k). This leads them to test different sets of cases: Trace 1 examines k=2, 3, 4, 5, 6, whereas Trace 2 examines k=1, 2, 3, 4. Trace 2 is more systematic and linear, finding the solution without backtracking. Trace 1 finds the equivalent solution but then enters a lengthy re-verification of all previously eliminated cases, which constitutes a loop. Trace 1 also briefly makes an error in evaluating its successful branch but recovers, while Trace 2 does not.
